title: T5: Adopt the permanent-evidence policy in AGENTS.md
description:
AUDIT REFERENCE: section 10.1.

PROBLEM
Nothing in repository authority states when a test earns permanent status, so
every reproducer produced during review becomes permanent by default. The
audit measured the result: 151 bead-named describe blocks across 52 files,
8,747 LOC of proof machinery tested by 17,736 LOC, and a 7,642-line SRD test
file organized by originating bead rather than by invariant.

REQUIRED WORK
Add a permanent-evidence policy to AGENTS.md. Proposed text is in audit
section 10.1; refine it against repository evidence rather than pasting it.
Load-bearing clauses:

- A permanent regression test protects a durable invariant, contract,
  independently meaningful boundary, or justified known defect class that
  stronger evidence does not already protect.
- A reproducer created during development or review is NOT automatically
  permanent. After disposition and repair it normally becomes generalized
  regression evidence or is retired, unless the exact case has independent
  semantic significance. EXACT SOURCE-FIDELITY REGRESSIONS AGAINST A VENDORED
  SOURCE ARTIFACT ALWAYS HAVE THAT SIGNIFICANCE and are never retired under
  this rule (docs/importer-fix-protocol.md).
- Tests are evidence of requirements, never authority for requirements.
- Permanent proof burden is proportionate to the governing invariant, and A
  PROOF MECHANISM'S OWN COST IS PART OF THAT PROPORTIONALITY. An assertion
  costing seconds of wall clock or hundreds of megabytes must be justified
  against a correspondingly serious consequence of failure. (F1 exists because
  nobody costed an assertion.)
- Proof machinery needs tests but DOES NOT INHERIT THE PROOF BURDEN OF THE
  PRODUCT. Test it in proportion to the decisions it gates.
- Infrastructure authorized for a bounded experiment or transition MUST CARRY
  AN EXPLICIT DISPOSITION AT THAT BOUNDARY -- retained as product
  implementation carrying a responsibility shipped behavior exercises,
  demoted to development-only tooling, or retired naming the responsibility
  that replaces it. Absent a stated disposition, scaffolding acquires
  permanent-contract status by default. (F3 exists because the transition
  design dispositioned every pre-existing artifact and none of the new
  scaffolding.)
  Judge this by RETAINED RESPONSIBILITY AND REAL RUNTIME USE, never by whether
  a symbol is exported from a package's public surface: per AGENTS.md core
  symbols default to internal, so private implementation is the normal,
  correct state for most product code.

ACCEPTANCE
- AGENTS.md carries the policy, sited so it governs both test authoring and
  review.
- It does not contradict docs/importer-fix-protocol.md or the standing ban on
  weakening SRD regressions.
- It states no test-count target.
- It creates no new proof machinery, checker, or required artifact.

EXCLUSIONS
This bead changes documentation only. It retires no existing test.
notes:
PR #553 (branch eshyra-9l5s-policy-path). Stays in_progress until that PR merges.
SCOPE AMENDED 2026-09-15 (PR #553 review, head ade2cdc5).

The 'EXCLUSIONS: documentation only. It retires no existing test.' line was wrong as written and is superseded for this bead. docs/design-and-pr-review-policy.md and AGENTS.md are ALREADY guarded by packages/core/test/reviewLifecyclePolicy.test.ts, so a documentation change to them is not test-neutral: editing the two-cycle clause broke that file's existing assertion, and no doc change of this kind can land without updating it. A documentation-only exclusion was therefore unsatisfiable.

AUTHORIZED, replacing the exclusion:
- Updating existing assertions in reviewLifecyclePolicy.test.ts that this bead's documentation change invalidates. Required, not optional.
- Adding guard assertions for the new AGENTS.md 'Permanent Test Evidence' section, in that same existing file.

Not authorized: any new test file, checker, script, or required artifact. That part of the original exclusion stands.

DISPOSITION under the standard this bead itself introduces:
- Governing invariant: AGENTS.md 'Permanent Test Evidence' exists and retains the absolute source-fidelity carve-out and the proof-cost clause.
- Authority: AGENTS.md is repository authority; docs/design-and-pr-review-policy.md binds every reviewer to it.
- Real consumer: every author and reviewer.
- Consequence of silent removal: the accretion loop the audit measured resumes, undetected.
- Evidence form: generalized clause assertions over document text, not reproducers.
- Cost: file read, ~1 ms. Proportionate to a repo-wide review contract.
- Mechanism: the pre-existing guard file, not new machinery.
PR #553 review at head ade2cdc5: CHANGES REQUESTED, 2 blockers, both repaired at head d5ce69b2. See the scope/wording amendment notes above.
DISPOSITION RULES RECONCILED 2026-09-17 (PR #553 fresh full review, head d5ce69b2).

DEFECT: T5's bounded-transition disposition contradicted T6's staged-authority rule and made omission a source of authority.

'retained' required that 'some shipped configuration exercises it'. That left authorized staged product implementation with NO valid disposition: 'retained' was forbidden for want of a current consumer, 'demoted' was false because it is not merely tooling, and 'retired' was false because the responsibility survives. T6 in the same PR explicitly says an accepted ADR/design/Bead may require an implementation before its consumer is integrated. The discovery subsystem is exactly that state, and it is the case the audit said must not be destroyed.

Separately, 'absent a stated disposition, scaffolding acquires permanent-contract status by default' made failure to perform a required decision CREATE a contract. That is the same error as treating code and tests as proof that behavior is required - the principle stated a few paragraphs earlier in the same section.

REPLACEMENT, now implemented in AGENTS.md:
- retained: a responsibility survives under current authority. If STAGED rather than live, say so and name the successor owner and next integration state.
- demoted: responsibility is genuinely tooling/diagnostic.
- retired: no responsibility survives; name the replacing responsibility where applicable.
- Current runtime use is NOT a condition of retention; it informs consequence and proof burden, exactly as reachability does under 'From observation to finding'.
- A missing disposition leaves the transition's exit UNRESOLVED and confers no permanent-contract status. The bounded transition is not validly closed until the decision is made.

EVIDENCE: one generalized assertion over the disposition invariant, added to the existing reviewLifecyclePolicy.test.ts guard. No new checker or test surface.
PR #553 fresh full review at head eaa6dc13 (2026-09-22): CHANGES REQUESTED, 2 blockers, both in this PR's own permanent evidence; the documents under review were not changed. Repaired at head 9c439373.
F1 layout-pinned assertion: the AGENTS.md disposition guard pinned a literal newline inside a hard-wrapped 111-char clause, contradicting the comment eleven lines above it in the same commit ('Assert the claim, not the layout'). It went red on a good-state rewrap. Replaced with the file's \s+ idiom. Sibling search found no other newline-pinned prose assertion in the repo's document guards.
F2 unguarded ordering claim: 'From observation to finding' states it runs before 'Findings discipline' and the gate only works upstream of it, but relocating the section left all 17 assertions green. Pinned with the indexOf idiom already used in this file. Documented upper bound only; no lower bound, since no authority states one.
Both verified against good AND bad states: green at two different wraps, red with the claim inverted, red with the section relocated after 'Findings discipline'.
Dispositioned 'no requirement' (one line each): AGENTS.md/policy retirement-clause duplication (different subjects, not the same rule); no stated locus for the one-line disposition (no authority requires raw observations to be published; 'Authority and required context' already obliges the reviewer to hold applicable authority); 'no test-count target' guard (scope exclusion, not durable invariant); retained/demoted/retired bullet-name guard (exceeds proportionate proof).
Verification at 9c439373: npm run verify:worktree clean, 5,611 passed / 3 skipped / 0 failed. Branch is off add173fa and does not carry PR #552's worker cap or measure-run wrapper.
Two-cycle rule: this is a new defect class, not a third dispatch on a surviving one.
PR #553 fresh full review at head eaa6dc13 (external reviewer): CHANGES REQUESTED, 1 blocker. Repaired at head 9dd31866.
BLOCKER: the source-fidelity carve-out was ABSOLUTE ('exact source-fidelity regressions ... are never retired under this rule') and cited docs/importer-fix-protocol.md as governing them. Verified contradiction: that protocol lines 83-84 permit 'a narrow assertion is replaced by a stronger invariant' and 'a local example test is replaced by broader audit coverage without losing the original regression intent'. AGENTS.md is repository authority and would have overridden the doc it points at, and the absolute form institutionalized the evidence accretion this epic exists to stop - source work could only ever accumulate permanent examples.
REPAIR (one defect class, three sites, together): the source-backed CLAIM is non-negotiable; the reproducer proving it may be consolidated into a stronger invariant or broader audit coverage ONLY where the replacement demonstrably preserves or strengthens that same protection, and never because a broad test already exists nearby. AGENTS.md now names the importer protocol as the owner of the substitution rules. The review policy's exact-reproducer wording is aligned and routed to the protocol. The guard assertion that pinned the absolute carve-out now pins the conditional invariant in both halves. Carve-out is not weakened: it attaches to the regression claim rather than the historical artifact.
EVIDENCE: existing guard assertions updated only; no new checker, test file, registry, or ledger. Verified green at the committed wrap and at rewraps to 68/74/88 columns; red with the absolute carve-out restored, red with the preserve-or-strengthen condition dropped, red with the 'a broad test already exists' escape reopened.
Verification at 9dd31866: npm run verify:worktree clean, 5,611 passed / 3 skipped / 0 failed. CI was green on the prior head 9c439373.
MATERIAL CHANGE to repository-authority semantics - head 9dd31866 requires another fresh full review before approval.
Note on the prior head: my own review of eaa6dc13 missed this blocker. I checked that the importer protocol contained the no-weakening rule the carve-out cited, but did not check whether it also contained a PERMISSION the carve-out contradicted. Verifying only the clause a cross-reference invokes, not the clause it overrides, is the gap.
PR #553 MERGED 2026-09-22 (merge commit 3f5693a0, reviewed head 9dd31866). Fresh full review of 9dd31866 clean: the repaired carve-out agrees with docs/importer-fix-protocol.md in both directions - line 22 no-weakening preserved, lines 83-84 substitution permitted under a preserve-or-strengthen condition, line 86 reporting requirement unaffected. Deliverable landed on main; bead closed.
